text:
mira: hey @devex, weird one — after I brew-installed redwoodctl on my M1 Mac the CLI can auth but local testing can't find my profile. redwoodctl created /usr/local/var/redwood instead of $HOME/.config/redwood and localserve says "no profile found". anyone seen this?

alex: what version and full output from `env` would help. also paste `redwoodctl --version`.

mira:
```
$ redwoodctl --version
redwoodctl version 0.9.2
$ env | grep -i xdg || true
XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/Users/mira/.config
BREW_PREFIX=/opt/homebrew
```
But the installer log shows it wrote to /usr/local/var/redwood: `mkdir -p /usr/local/var/redwood && chown mira:staff /usr/local/var/redwood`

sam: this is classic homebrew-on-arm path confusion. installer script probably detects /usr/local presence and falls back. on M1 the prefix is /opt/homebrew so writes to /usr/local by mistake. localserve checks $XDG_CONFIG_HOME first so it misses /usr/local. quick workaround: `export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/.config && redwoodctl localserve --profile default` or symlink /usr/local/var/redwood -> $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/redwood.

jen: filed a tiny issue — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/issues/412 — TL;DR: installer should use `$(brew --prefix)` or prefer $XDG_CONFIG_HOME. linking note: `ln -s "$HOME/.config/redwood" /usr/local/var/redwood` if you want quick parity.

alex: short-term patch you can run locally:
```
# make localserve check /usr/local fallback
REDWOOD_CONFIG="$HOME/.config/redwood" redwoodctl localserve
# OR fix perms if you want installer path usable
sudo chown -R $(whoami):staff /usr/local/var/redwood
```
Also added a one-line guard in my head: if [ -z "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME" ] then check /usr/local/var/redwood; else prefer XDG. I'll put a quick PR. :thumbsup:

mira: tried `REDWOOD_CONFIG="$HOME/.config/redwood" redwoodctl localserve` — works. local entries load and auth token is read. thanks all! will avoid reinstall until PR lands. :relieved:

jen: thanks for the repro steps — adding a test to CI to ensure M1/homebrew path handling. closing the loop once PR + release done. :rocket:
